name: SelfManager.ai
description_en:
SelfManager.ai is a product in the Project management category. Its directory profile covers AI Assistant, Timeline View, Project Templates, Idea Management, Custom Workflows, Recurring Task Management, Task Management, Status Tracking.

Additional listed capabilities include Requirement Management, Project Planning, Project Portfolio Management, Percent-Complete Tracking, Milestone Tracking. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $8.00.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: use model-assisted interactions within the product workflow; create, assign and track units of work; track significant project checkpoints. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
SelfManager.ai 属于项目管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括AI 助手、时间轴视图、项目模板、创意管理、自定义工作流、周期任务管理、任务管理、状态跟踪。

资料还列出需求管理、项目规划、项目组合管理、完成百分比跟踪、里程碑跟踪。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为中型企业 小型企业 自由职业者 个人用户。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $8.00.。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：在产品工作流中使用模型辅助交互；创建、分配并跟踪具体工作任务；跟踪项目中的重要检查节点。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
